About Us

CALSTART is a mission-driven industry organization focused on transportation decarbonization and clean air for all.

For over 30 years, CALSTART’s mission is to develop, assess, and implement large-scale, zero-emission transportation solutions to mitigate climate change and support economic growth. CALSTART works with businesses, organizations, governments, and communities to create real-life impact toward clean air and equitable access to clean transportation for all. CALSTART provides scientific, technical and policy support for regulatory development and clean technology and infrastructure acceleration.

About the Role

The purpose of the Project Manager 2, Trucks role is to ensure the effective implementation and management of Incentive Projects and other CALSTART initiatives. This involves educating and training stakeholders, improving technical systems, streamlining administrative processes, and ensuring data management and reporting. By coordinating with internal teams and engaging external stakeholders, the role will support project successes and foster strong relationships within the industry and with regulatory bodies.

The Project Manager 2, Trucks role will support external stakeholders by educating and training dealers and equipment purchasers, addressing their inquiries, and assisting with Salesforce technical issues to ensure smooth participation in the incentive projects. For internal stakeholders, the role will streamline project administration, update incentive websites and equipment catalogs, and handle data acquisition and reporting. They will lead the development of standard operating procedures, help organize events and webinars, draft communications, and ensure coordinated efforts and effective project execution. This role also involves collaborating with internal teams and engaging with industry participants and funders to maintain stakeholder relationships and support the overall success of CALSTART initiatives.

Duties & Responsibilities

  • Lead dealer education initiative and involvement, training dealers and purchasers on participating in the incentive projects (e.g. responding to inquiry emails, assisting with or escalating Salesforce technical issues, preparing presentations to inform how the voucher processes work, etc.)
  • Assist with all tasks related to administering incentive projects by fulfilling functions as outlined in grant agreements, including but not limited to developing Implementation Manuals, policies, and procedures, streamlining voucher approval and processing workflows in Salesforce, and engaging industry stakeholders.
  • Develop and maintain strong relationships with participating OEMs and dealers to drive outreach initiatives, manage and oversee equipment eligibility verification and catalog management while developing and implementing standard operating procedures (SOPs) to streamline processes and ensure accuracy and consistency across projects
  • Input new OEMs, Dealers, and Equipment to the Voucher Processing Center catalog, provide feedback to the Salesforce development team on system processes for improvements or maintenance, and lead efforts to improve the dealer user experience of Voucher Processing Center, and assist the Voucher Processing team with system issues or processing inquiries.
  • Help with monthly data acquisition, validation, and reporting (e.g. manage vendor data collection process, work with internal data and validation team to create monthly reports) and keep records for engagements and meetings with internal and external stakeholders.
  • Use CALSTART CRM (Customer Relationship Management) systems such as Salesforce and Monday.com to keep and maintain records and perform and track daily tasks.
  • Lead the development of standard operating procedures for internal processes and using project management tools to further develop enhancements of the program as it pertains to reporting, program funding launches, and program development.
  • Support organizing and attending project-related workshops, events, forums, presentations, and webinars, such as drafting announcement emails and presentation slides, coordinating with communications managing webinars, and strategize communication tactics for workgroups and webinars
  • Assist with other tasks or other CALSTART initiatives as requested by other teams/departments

Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience in project management, with strong skills in timeline development, resource allocation, budget management, risk assessment, and cross-functional team coordination.
  • 1-2 years of experience with Salesforce, including skills in custom object creation, workflow automation, report generation, data management, and user administration.
  • Project management experience demonstrating proficiency in scope definition, team leadership, quality assurance, and stakeholder engagement.
  • Experience with Salesforce, including skills in data integration, process automation, dashboard creation, and system customization.
  • Experience supporting diverse stakeholders, with skills in effective communication, conflict resolution, needs assessment, and tailored solution delivery.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage and streamline administrative workflows, with skills in process optimization, documentation management, and workflow automation.
  • Proven ability to work effectively with internal teams and external stakeholders, utilizing collaboration tools, stakeholder management techniques, cross-functional coordination, and conflict resolution strategies.
  • Bachelor's degree in Environmental Science, Public Policy, Business Administration, or related fields, with skills in data analysis, project management, policy development, and stakeholder communication.

Desired Qualifications

  • Experience in sales, with a demonstrated ability to build and maintain strong relationships with external stakeholders, fostering collaboration and mutual support.
  • Experience in the Zero-Emission Vehicle (ZEV) industry or related initiatives, showcasing a strong understanding of industry-specific trends and regulations.

Salary: $72,000 - $85,760 a year

CALSTART values transparency and strives to provide as much information regarding compensation as possible. The complete salary range for this role is $72,000-$85,760. Pay is determined based on several factors, including but not limited to job-related skills, qualifications, experience, education, internal equity and other factors relevant to the job.

We’re a tight-knit team of world-class innovators, business minds, and change agents who believe passionately in our mission and put our team ahead of self. We are committed to the continued development and growth of our employees and invest in your success!

n8n is a workflow automation platform that uniquely combines AI capabilities with business process automation. We give technical teams the flexibility of code with the speed of no-code, backed by a passionate community of builders. With 500+ integrations and fair-code principles, we're revolutionizing how businesses connect their systems and processes.

We were founded end of 2019 and currently:

  • We’re a diverse team of + 140 talented people
  • Our annual recurring revenue is growing over 9x year-over-year
  • With +130k GitHub stars, we are in the top 50 most popular projects of all time on GitHub
  • We were the 25th fastest growing startup last year and 4th BtoB SaaS Rising 100 this year in Europe according to Sifted
  • We were Sequoia's first seed investment in Germany, and most recently secured our $60M Series B (February '25, led by Highland)

Role

As a Senior Technical Writer , you’ll be a key voice of clarity in a complex, highly technical product space. You’ll craft and maintain high-quality documentation and learning resources — from technical deep dives to onboarding flows and integration how-tos — making n8n approachable and empowering for developers and technical users.

Current docs

If you’re excited about shaping docs that truly help users succeed — and you already see ways we could improve — this role could be perfect for you.

Mission

  • Write and ship high-quality, user-centered documentation — from quickstart guides to advanced API walkthroughs and real-world use cases.
  • Collaborate with Engineering, Product, DevRel, and Support to ensure docs answer the right questions at the right time.
  • Bring clarity and accessibility to complex technical concepts, empowering developers to self-serve.
  • Continuously improve the docs experience, identifying gaps, proposing enhancements, and iterating based on feedback.
  • Elevate the voice and tone of n8n docs: clear, helpful, and friendly — no jargon, no fluff.
  • Support our community of contributors by reviewing submissions and making it easy to collaborate on high-quality content.

Must-have

  • 5+ years creating technical documentation for developer-facing products.
  • Experience with Docs-as-Code workflows, using tools like Git, Markdown, and static site generators.
  • Comfort diving into technical concepts — APIs, JavaScript, JSON — and exploring tools like n8n hands-on.
  • Proven ability to write with structure and clarity while keeping tone warm and accessible.
  • Strong understanding of how documentation impacts adoption, engagement, and developer experience.

Nice-to-have

  • Background in engineering, computer science, or a related technical field.
  • You actively still code
  • Prior experience working in open-source or with developer communities.
  • Familiarity with workflow automation tools or low-code platforms.

n8n is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

Company Culture

  • Flat management structure with direct access to decision-makers.
  • Friendly, collaborative U.S.-based team empowering innovation.
  • Open communication environment.
  • No bureaucracy or rigid hierarchies.
  • Results-oriented approach.

Por que ingressar na Keller

Alcance e impacto globais

Ingresse em uma empresa internacional de recrutamento de executivos de alto nível com alcance mundial. Você terá exposição aos mercados dos EUA, às partes interessadas globais e à aquisição de talentos de alto nível que impulsionam o crescimento transformador dos negócios.

Aceleração da carreira

Prospera em uma estrutura horizontal e orientada para resultados, com acesso direto aos tomadores de decisão, oferecendo rápido desenvolvimento profissional, aprendizado prático em recrutamento de executivos e caminhos claros para expandir suas responsabilidades em uma organização em expansão.

Cultura colaborativa e inclusiva

Junte-se a uma equipe amigável que promove a comunicação aberta, celebra a diversidade e valoriza a inovação — livre de burocracia, com foco no trabalho em equipe e contribuições significativas para conectar os melhores talentos a oportunidades que mudam vidas.

Integração entre vida profissional e pessoal

Aproveite a flexibilidade do trabalho remoto em um ambiente acolhedor que prioriza o seu bem-estar, ao mesmo tempo em que faz uma diferença tangível em setores em todo o mundo por meio de práticas de recrutamento éticas e de alto padrão.

Crescimento profissional incomparável

Aproveite as oportunidades de trabalhar em projetos diversificados e de alto impacto, incluindo avaliações de liderança e serviços de consultoria de RH, em uma empresa comprometida com a excelência, o sucesso do cliente e o desenvolvimento de longo prazo dos funcionários.

Política de Igualdade de Oportunidades de Emprego e Não Discriminação

Declaração de Igualdade de Oportunidades de Emprego:

Tanto a Keller quanto seus clientes são empregadores que oferecem igualdade de oportunidades. Para todas as vagas, os candidatos qualificados serão considerados para o emprego, independentemente de raça, cor da pele, religião, sexo, orientação sexual, identidade de gênero, expressão de gênero, nacionalidade, idade, estado civil, deficiência, gravidez, informações genéticas ou qualquer outra condição protegida pela legislação trabalhista brasileira ou outras leis aplicáveis.

Compromisso com a Diversidade:

Tanto a Keller quanto seus clientes estão comprometidos em promover ambientes de trabalho diversificados e inclusivos, onde todos os indivíduos são valorizados e respeitados. Acreditamos que a diversidade impulsiona a inovação e o sucesso e nos esforçamos para criar locais de trabalho onde todos possam prosperar.

Acomodações razoáveis:

Tanto a Keller quanto seus clientes estão comprometidos em fornecer acomodações razoáveis para pessoas com deficiência ou grávidas, em conformidade com as leis trabalhistas brasileiras. Nos envolvemos em um processo interativo para identificar acomodações eficazes para garantir acesso igualitário às oportunidades de emprego.

Informações sobre remuneração:

As informações sobre salários e remuneração serão disponibilizadas durante o processo de entrevista, de acordo com as regulamentações trabalhistas locais. Quando necessário, as faixas salariais serão incluídas nas vagas anunciadas. As ofertas salariais reais podem variar de acordo com as habilidades, experiência e estruturas salariais aplicáveis.

Conformidade com as leis:

Tanto a Keller quanto seus clientes cumprem todas as leis trabalhistas brasileiras aplicáveis relativas à não discriminação no emprego. Esta política se aplica a todos os termos e condições de emprego, incluindo recrutamento, contratação, colocação, promoção, rescisão, demissão, recontratação, transferência, licenças, remuneração e treinamento.

Assédio no local de trabalho:

Tanto a Keller quanto seus clientes proíbem expressamente qualquer forma de assédio ou discriminação no local de trabalho com base em raça, cor da pele, religião, gênero, orientação sexual, identidade ou expressão de gênero, nacionalidade, idade, informação genética, deficiência ou qualquer outro status protegido pela legislação brasileira. Estamos comprometidos em manter ambientes de trabalho seguros e respeitosos para todos os funcionários.

Privacidade e equidade salarial:

Tanto a Keller quanto seus clientes se dedicam à equidade salarial e revisam periodicamente as práticas de remuneração para garantir a justiça e a conformidade com as leis aplicáveis. A privacidade dos funcionários é respeitada e todos os dados pessoais serão tratados de acordo com as leis brasileiras de proteção de dados, como a Lei de Proteção de Dados Pessoais.

Status de veterano e serviço nacional:

Tanto a Keller quanto seus clientes oferecem oportunidades iguais de emprego a veteranos e cumprem as leis relacionadas às preferências de emprego para indivíduos que cumpriram suas obrigações de serviço national.

title: Manager, Commercial Sales
description:
Role Summary

We are looking for an experienced Manager of Commercial Sales to lead a Sales Team focused on new business generation in the 1-250 space. This role will require strong leadership skills to manage and develop a team of inside sales professionals who drive sales efforts and generate new business opportunities within a specified region. You will guide your team to build a robust pipeline, meet/exceed sales targets, and foster long-term customer relationships. The ideal candidate will have a proven track record of successfully managing inside sales teams in a Channel environment.

About Us

Sophos is a global leader and innovator of advanced security solutions for defeating cyberattacks. The company acquired Secureworks in February 2025, bringing together two pioneers that have redefined the cybersecurity industry with their innovative, native AI-optimized services, technologies and products. Sophos is now the largest pure-play Managed Detection and Response (MDR) provider, supporting more than 28,000 organizations. In addition to MDR and other services, Sophos’ complete portfolio includes industry-leading endpoint, network, email, and cloud security that interoperate and adapt to defend through the Sophos Central platform. Secureworks provides the innovative, market-leading Taegis XDR/MDR, identity threat detection and response (ITDR), next-gen SIEM capabilities, managed risk, and a comprehensive set of advisory services. Sophos sells all these solutions through reseller partners, Managed Service Providers (MSPs) and Managed Security Service Providers (MSSPs) worldwide, defending more than 600,000 organizations worldwide from phishing, ransomware, data theft, other everyday and state-sponsored cybercrimes. The solutions are powered by historical and real-time threat intelligence from Sophos X-Ops and the newly added Counter Threat Unit (CTU). Sophos is headquartered in Oxford, U.K. More information is available at

What You Will Do

  • Team Leadership: Lead and mentor a team of inside sales representatives, driving performance to consistently meet or exceed new business sales targets. Foster a positive and results-driven environment that encourages growth, learning, and accountability.
  • New Business Strategy: Develop and implement sales strategies to enable your team to identify and pursue new business opportunities within your designated region. Guide and support your team in executing strategies to generate new leads, nurture prospects, and close deals.
  • Performance Management: Monitor and evaluate the sales performance of your team. Provide coaching, feedback, and training to ensure individual and team success. Set clear expectations, establish KPIs, and ensure that the team stays focused on delivering results.
  • Partner and Distributor Coordination: Collaborate with partners and distributors to ensure alignment on sales strategies and goals. Help manage relationships between your sales team and key partners to ensure that indirect sales are growing effectively.
  • Sales Process Optimization: Lead efforts to streamline and improve the sales process, ensuring your team has the tools, resources, and training necessary to close deals efficiently and effectively. Monitor sales cycles and ensure timely follow-up and conversion.
  • Training and Development: Continuously develop your team's skills through regular training sessions, workshops, and best-practice sharing. Identify areas for professional growth and provide opportunities for career advancement.
  • Cross-functional Collaboration: Work closely with other teams (Sales Engineering, Marketing, Customer Care, etc.) to provide comprehensive support throughout the sales cycle, ensuring that your team has the resources to close deals successfully.
  • Sales Forecasting and Reporting: Provide accurate and timely sales forecasts and performance reports. Ensure that the team tracks activities and results in the CRM system, and use data to identify trends, opportunities, and areas for improvement.
  • Conflict Resolution and Negotiation: Guide your team in managing conflicts with partners or customers, offering support when difficult negotiations arise. Help facilitate solutions that maintain strong relationships and drive sales growth.
  • Market Insights and Feedback: Gather feedback from your team about market conditions, customer needs, and competitor activity. Work with leadership and product teams to refine sales strategies and ensure alignment with market demands.
  • Event Representation and Networking: Occasionally represent Sophos at trade shows, conferences, or partner events, where you will help facilitate discussions and drive new business opportunities for your team.
  • Sales Tools and CRM Management: Ensure that your team is utilizing CRM systems, sales tools, and business systems effectively to track progress, manage opportunities, and maintain accurate records of all activities.

What You Will Bring

  • Proven experience managing inside sales teams with a focus on driving new business in a Channel environment
  • Strong leadership skills, with the ability to coach, motivate, and develop sales professionals to achieve and exceed sales targets.
  • Solid understanding of the sales process and ability to optimize and scale sales efforts for inside sales teams
  • Experience managing indirect sales efforts and building strong relationships with partners and distributors.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills with a demonstrated ability to influence, inspire, and manage a high-performance sales team.
  • Strong coaching and mentoring abilities, with a focus on developing the skills of team members in areas like lead generation, cold calling, and closing sales.
  • Familiarity with CRM systems (Salesforce or similar) and sales tools, with the ability to use data to track performance and make decisions.
  • Strategic thinker who can align team efforts with overall business goals and objectives.
  • Strong problem-solving and conflict-resolution skills.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, or related field is preferred

What’s Great About Sophos?

• Sophos operates a remote-first working model, making remote work the primary option for most employees. However, some roles may necessitate a hybrid approach. While we are a remote first organization, applicants must have legal authorization to work in the jurisdiction where the position is posted, without requiring employer sponsorship.

• Our people – we innovate and create, all of which are accompanied by a great sense of fun and team spirit

• Employee-led diversity and inclusion networks that build community and provide education and advocacy

• Annual charity and fundraising initiatives and volunteer days for employees to support local communities

• Global employee sustainability initiatives to reduce our environmental footprint

• Global fitness and trivia competitions to keep our bodies and minds sharp

• Global wellbeing days for employees to relax and recharge

• Monthly wellbeing webinars and training to support employee health and wellbeing

Our Commitment To You

We’re proud of the diverse and inclusive environment we have at Sophos, and we’re committed to ensuring equality of opportunity. We believe that diversity, combined with excellence, builds a better Sophos, so we encourage applicants who can contribute to the diversity of our team. All applicants will be treated in a fair and equal manner and in accordance with the law regardless of gender, sex, gender reassignment, marital status, race, religion or belief, color, age, military veteran status, disability, pregnancy, maternity or sexual orientation. We want to give you every opportunity to show us your best self, so if there are any adjustments we could make to the recruitment and selection process to support you, please let us know.

Data Protection

If you choose to explore an opportunity, and subsequently share your CV or other personal details with Sophos, these details will be held by Sophos for 12 months in accordance with our Privacy Policy and used by our recruitment team to contact you regarding this or other relevant opportunities at Sophos. If you would like Sophos to delete or update your details at any time, please follow the steps set out in the Privacy Policy describing your individual rights. Diferenciais

  • MLOps / produção: gráficos de detecção de drift de dados. Distribuição de probabilidades de saída (overconfidence).
  • Métricas de latência/throughput. Consumo de GPU/CPU/memória em inferência.

title: Senior QA Automation Engineer
description:
Overview

Upgrade helps customers move in the right direction with affordable and responsible financial products. Since 2017, we’ve helped over 7 million customers access over $40 billion in consumer credit. With a relentless focus on improving our customers' financial well-being, we build products that put more money in their pocket and support their journey toward a better financial future. We’re backed by prominent technology investors and were valued at $6.3B.

We’re consistently recognized for our collaborative and inclusive culture. We were named one of the World’s Top Fintech Companies by CNBC, Best Places to Work by Built In, Best Places to Work by the San Francisco Business Times, America’s Greatest Workplaces by Newsweek, Best Startup Employer by Forbes, and Healthiest Employers by Phoenix Business Journal.

We’re looking for new team members who get excited about designing and delivering new and better products. Come join us and help build a better financial future for millions of people.

About the Role

Upgrade is a US based company with numerous fully remote engineering team members across Brazil. Our QA team has end-to-end ownership to build a quality product. Through automation and functional testing, they validate a variety of products to offer our customers a seamless banking experience. As a QA Engineer, you will work directly with our product teams and will participate in application specification reviews and architectural design sessions by providing input from a quality standpoint. You will also identify testing strategies for various features and functionalities. Within your first year, you will develop an understanding of how to deliver high performing software at pace of development. You will work in an environment that promotes ownership at all levels including configuring and monitoring apps in production.

What You’ll Do

  • Execute functional/performance tests by spinning up disposable environments on demand to deploy microservices with different versions and configurations, and customize database content
  • Develop test automation at the pace of feature development utilizing our functional and performance test frameworks
  • Customize, configure, patch services, and deploy infrastructure and code changes all the way through to production
  • Analyze log files and troubleshoot production issues by automating and reproducing them in a non-production environment
  • Plan, create, and implement strategies/solutions for feature validations and test automation

What We Look For

  • Ability to develop test automation in Java using Selenium to utilize Integrated Development Environments (IDE) such as IntelliJ or Eclipse
  • Experience in deploying services in various environments such as Kubernetes, using deployment tools like ArgoCD and Jenkins
  • Familiarity with log aggregators such as SumoLogic, Kibana, or Splunk, and app monitoring tools such as Honeycomb or Grafana
  • Experience writing SQL queries and working in a cloud-based environment (AWS)
  • Passion for automating tests and delivering high quality features in a fast paced environment
  • Comfortable working in Agile methodology

We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

Upgrade does not accept unsolicited resumes from staffing agencies, search firms, or any third parties. English is required for all positions, as it involves interacting with staff at Upgrade's offices worldwide.

Demographic Questions & Categorizations

Upgrade is dedicated to building a diverse team and an inclusive culture. We are asking candidates to voluntarily self-identify through demographic questions to help assess outreach and diversity representation goals. Your responses are stored in aggregate and will not be linked to your identity or your application. Participation is voluntary and will not affect your candidacy.

description:
Senior Site Reliability Engineer — Affirmative Position for Women

We\'re looking for a talented and passionate Site Reliability Engineer to join Wildlife\'s Cloud Platform team.

As an SRE, your goal will be to provide easy-to-use, highly available systems for all engineers in the company. Within the Cloud Platform team, your main focus will be on improving infrastructure services—leveraging and refining existing automations while contributing to the development of new services that enhance scalability and usability.

We know that the work we do has a high impact on Wildlife’s success and culture. The right person for this position is curious, proactive, passionate about problem-solving, and thrives in a fast-paced, growing environment.

Diversity & Inclusion at Wildlife

This is a Diversity & Inclusion position, exclusively for women.

At Wildlife, we encourage everyone to bring their whole selves to work every day. We believe that diverse and inclusive teams are key to driving innovation and taking our company to the next level. Our teams are multicultural and spread across the globe, and as we continue to grow, we strive to create an environment where people from all backgrounds feel valued and empowered.

Happiness has no gender, no skin color, no age, and no badge. Everyone deserves to feel happy and fulfilled. That’s why we invest in diversity initiatives such as Wild Pride, Wild Panthers, and Women++, ensuring that our values, rituals, benefits, and people programs reflect our commitment to inclusion.

What you\'ll do

  • Be part of a cross-functional team, directly contributing to feature development and maintenance of existing and new infrastructure services;
  • Develop, maintain, and optimize infrastructure clusters (Kubernetes, NATS, ETCD, Postgres, MongoDB, Redis, Elasticsearch, etc.) and infrastructure services (Gitlab, Jenkins, Vault, Artifactory, Datadog, Jaeger, etc.);
  • Manage the infrastructure required to run build pipelines on both Linux and macOS nodes in our cloud environment;
  • Define monitoring and observability patterns for infrastructure services;
  • Troubleshoot and manage incidents in production;
  • Manage and improve the tools and processes related to infrastructure management across the company (Infrastructure-as-code standards, CI/CD design, build of our Internal Developer Platform, etc.);
  • Help partner teams to architect and scale their applications and infrastructure with Cloud best practices.

What you\'ll need

  • Solid coding experience in at least one programming language. We work mostly with Go and Python;
  • University degree in courses related to computing such as Computer Engineering, Computer Science, Information Systems, and Systems Analysis and Development or equivalent Market Experience;
  • Solid understanding of computer concepts (operational systems, networking, concurrency, memory management, and algorithm analysis);
  • Experience with cloud computing services such as Amazon AWS, Google Cloud, or Microsoft Azure;
  • Experience with Infrastructure as Code automations, such as Terraform, Packer, Ansible, Crossplane, etc;
  • Experience automating routine tasks, such as deployments and monitoring setup;
  • Experience with incident management and being oncall for productive systems and workloads;
  • Excellent written communication skills in English, including reading and drafting document;
  • Experience with complex, large-scale, and high-available systems;
  • Experience with monitoring and telemetry in applications and infrastructure;
  • History of technical leadership and ownership of critical projects, including the mentoring of junior team members;

Nice to have

  • Experience in building and automating mobile workloads and their technology (iOS, Android, Flutter, etc.).
  • Extra Bonus if related to gaming (e.g Unity, Godot).

More about you

  • Player focused. We are player-oriented, and infrastructure has a great impact on their experience. You have empathy with our players and focus on ensuring they have an amazing experience. You aim for a top-level infrastructure, guaranteeing the highest availability possible.
  • Automation is key to scaling. We look for engineers who have a history of projecting and executing automation projects in order to get rid of any manual and repetitive tasks.
  • Calm and pragmatism. When everything seems to be falling apart around you, you have a plan and keep calm.
  • Bleeding edge. You are curious and like to study new technologies, test new solutions, and measure the impact brought by changes. We want to ensure we are using the best stack possible
  • Metrics-oriented. We make decisions based on data and metrics. We measure the results of our tasks against the expected outcome. And we ensure our work has delivered the correct impact on our customers. We believe in ownership and in shipping features end to end.
  • Bar raiser. You want to elevate your team skills and raise the bar, by mentoring your peers, spreading knowledge, being proactive and a tech lead.

About Wildlife

Wildlife is one of the world’s leading mobile game developers and publishers. We have released over 60 titles, reaching billions of players worldwide. We create games that excite, intrigue, and engage players for years to come!

Wildlife is proud to be an Equal Opportunity and Affirmative Action employer. We do not discriminate based on race, color, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, or any other legally protected characteristic.

title: Senior Software Engineer (Lending)
description:
About the Role

You will work closely with the product and credit teams to build go-to-market functions for our lending decisioning engine. You’ll debug and resolve complex issues independently, anticipate potential blockers, and help unblock others when needed.

You will evaluate scope and requirements critically by surfacing ambiguities early, challenging assumptions, and reframing trade-offs to ensure clarity before execution. Progress, risks, and blockers should be communicated proactively through tickets, stand-ups, and async updates to keep teammates and stakeholders aligned.

You will provide detailed peer reviews that improve code quality, maintainability, and extensibility. In addition, you’ll drive continuous improvement by identifying technical debt, proposing design or tooling enhancements, and sharing best practices that increase team velocity and reliability.

About the Team

The team develops Clutch's real-time lending decisioning engine. We work closely with Credit, Product, and Implementation teams to increase auto-decision rates and reduce funding time for our credit union partners. The team operates with a clear cadence and shared rituals, using narrative-driven planning and continuous improvement to ship reliably while collaborating across the broader Lending org.

Engineers own outcomes end to end, from discovery and decision-ready specs through rollout, monitoring, and follow-ups.

What You’ll Do

Within 3 months, you will:

  • Debug and resolve issues independently, providing clear root-cause analysis and documenting learnings.

  • Take ownership of smaller features end-to-end, from clarifying requirements to deployment.

  • Build working knowledge of decisioning engine features and rules, being able to explain their impact on the product.

  • Proactively ask questions, surface risks, and challenge assumptions early to improve clarity and scope of work.

Within 6 months, you will:

  • Drive predictable delivery by proactively communicating progress, risks, and blockers without being prompted.

  • Confidently operate on lending decisioning context, making informed tradeoffs and documenting decisions.

  • Lead technical implementation for a feature or partner go-live, coordinating with stakeholders for alignment.

  • Anticipate potential problems in requirements or design, reframing them with data and alternative solutions before they become blockers.

  • Contribute high-quality code reviews that not only ensure standards, but also provide mentorship and elevate peers’ design and coding practices.

Within 9 months, you will:

  • Lead and deliver a small-to-medium scoped project independently, including technical design, planning, and rollout.

  • Build trust with cross-functional and external stakeholders by representing engineering context and constraints clearly.

  • Proactively identify technical debt or process gaps and drive initiatives to resolve them with measurable impact.

  • Demonstrate readiness for the next level by consistently owning delivery, influencing peers, and shaping team practices that raise the overall bar.

What You’ll Bring

  • Strong product-oriented mindset, able to connect technical decisions with business impact.

  • Proven ability to debug and resolve complex issues independently, providing clear root-cause analysis and documenting learnings.

  • Experience collaborating cross-functionally with Product, Credit, Implementation, and external stakeholders to align on scope and trade-offs.

  • Consistent ownership of small-to-medium projects end-to-end, from discovery and design to deployment and follow-up.

  • Ability to critically evaluate requirements, anticipate risks, and propose pragmatic alternatives that improve clarity and delivery outcomes.

  • Advanced English skills, both spoken and written.

  • Plus: previous experience with loan origination systems is a strong differentiator.

Please note that this role may evolve as our business needs change, so we appreciate your flexibility and adaptability.

What’s In It For You?

  • Remote Flexibility: Enjoy the freedom of remote work from anywhere, balancing life and career seamlessly.

  • Unforgettable Off-Sites: Twice a year, bond with colleagues in exciting destinations, fostering teamwork and fresh ideas.

  • Paid Time Off and National Holidays: Enjoy 20 PTO days yearly and the National Holidays for relaxation and rejuvenation.

  • Stock Options: Joining us means having a stake in our success, so you'll receive stock options as part of your compensation package.

  • Home Office Setup: Create your ideal workspace with a dedicated budget for home office essentials.

  • Work Trip Budget: Grow personally and professionally with a budget for work-related trips and co-working.

About Us

Clutch is a revolutionary vertical SaaS company, proudly backed by Andreessen Horowitz (A16z), aimed at revolutionizing the way Credit Unions engage and change the lives of their members. As a champion of financial well-being, we address the urgent need for affordable lending solutions in an era where the average American grapples with over $155,000 in household debt. Unlike traditional financial institutions, Clutch develops software to turn Credit Unions into FinTech lenders and leverage their balance sheets to responsibly lend to over 130M Americans. Our mission extends beyond mere financial transactions; we strive to fundamentally enhance the way credit unions interact with their members. By integrating cutting-edge technologies and user-centric designs, we help credit unions provide seamless digital experiences that are on par with leading tech companies. This approach not only preserves but revitalizes the longstanding tradition of community and member-focused service inherent to credit unions.

Please note: This position is offered on a contractor basis. Applicants must have the necessary documentation and authorization to work in the country where the job is located. Clutch cannot provide sponsorship or assist with obtaining work permits for this role.

That said, during the interview process, we want to hear your thoughts. Please approach interviews without the use of AI tools—our goal is to get to know how you think, solve problems, and communicate. Once you're in the seat, bring on the prompts!

title: Product Director, Feegow (100% remote-friendly within Brazil)
description:
Company Description

Welcome to the good side of tech

You might have heard about us but with a different name: Feegow, Doctoralia or Docplanner. The names are different depending on the country we are located in, but we are all part of Docplanner Group.

It all started over 12 years ago when we asked ourselves: is anyone in healthcare thinking about patients? We jumped in and we empowered patients by giving them access to leave and read reviews about their visit. We then provided doctors with the technology to manage bookings easily and save time, so they could devote themselves to what they always wanted: treating patients. And today is the day in which we ask you: wanna join us in the next step helping people live longer and healthier lives?

Where does Feegow fit here?

In 2022 Feegow joined the Docplanner Group, a health-tech company. We are dedicated to developing innovative solutions and promoting access to top-tier management for physicians seeking to take their practices to the next level, as well as managers in search of a robust solution that covers end-to-end operations. Our ultimate goal is to create a world where everyone can access high-quality healthcare.

Docplanner Group at scale

We are leaders in 13 countries so far, and more than 50 million patients trust us every month. 300.000+ specialists believe in us and our product, and so do leading venture capital funds such as Point Nine Capital, Goldman Sachs Asset Management and One Peak Partners. And yet, employing over 2.500 people all over the globe, we managed to keep the startup-mindset we started with over 12 years ago.

And why should you join us?

Because it feels good to tell your family and your friends how you made the world a little bit better. You go to bed knowing that what you do matters, and that your talents align with your beliefs.

We want to make the healthcare experience more human, and that starts with you being you. We believe that considering the diversity of human experience makes a better healthcare experience for all. We’re not just different: we embrace diversity. We will encourage you to come to work your whole self, and that includes not coming to the office at all if you prefer not to, as we\'re 100% remote-friendly.

Remote model: you can work 100% from home, but you are also welcome in our offices in Curitiba and Rio de Janeiro.

Job Description

Feegow is the leading Practice Management System (PMS) in Brazil for individual doctors & large clinics alike, and a highly strategic product for Docplanner Group, as a foundation to conquer the Brazilian market.

We are looking for a passionate and experienced Director of Product for Feegow to lead our product teams, drive innovation, accountability, and play a key role in our product\'s modernization. This is a remote-friendly role within Brazil, where you’ll foster collaboration between global teams, steer product development, and manage a talented product team. Your expertise in building a data-driven & business minded product culture whilst delivering fast & safe iterations, knowing when to go for PoCs & robust solutions based on the business appetite and product maturity will ensure the continued growth of Feegow and Docplanner Group.

What we expect from this position:

  • Inspire, lead and bring in PMS product vision to all product managers and teams.
  • Understand a complex environment where the teams have not only individual doctors and clinics that should be delighted with their Efficiency platform, whilst bringing them new value propositions like Visibility & Growth, as well as betting on AI as a door opener for exponential value.
  • Define with PMs the product strategy on every team, how it relates to the broader Brazilian strategy & Docplanner Tech & Product strategy.
  • Influence and establish a shared vision with other business areas as Sales, Operations and Marketing. Be a key stakeholder for Individuals and Clinics Business owners.
  • Ensure upcoming product needs and opportunities aligned with your Engineering Director and Country Managers to create a coherent Product & Tech Strategy and Roadmap.
  • Champion a hands-on approach to innovation by using a combination of Data, listening to the market, and “getting out of the building” to get first-hand customer/user insights.
  • Create a culture of decision-making based on insight, analysis and data across the business.
  • Work closely with our Global VP Product, on standardizing the objectives in clear indicators & tasks and bring transparency on ‘the plan’ across the whole company.

Qualifications

  • Minimum 3 years’ work experience as Product Director / GPM (managing and coaching a group of Product Managers)
  • Experience on B2B SaaS scale-ups
  • Solid experience in fast high-growth environment, change management, & business growth
  • A proven track record of delivering significant success, scaling and developing high performing digital products that impact business & delight customers
  • Expertise in the end-to-end product development lifecycle, agile and lean software development practices
  • An entrepreneurial mindset with outstanding organizational, communicative and leadership skills
  • Business savvy, holistic business acumen outside of Product Management and ability to assess product market fit
  • Analytical abilities and problem-solving skills
  • Experience in healthcare is a plus not a must
  • Experience in modernizing tech debt whilst delivering product value is a plus
  • Hands-on: In Docplanner, being a people manager does not mean only managing people, but being able to dive in the details of problems, opportunities & solutions.

Additional Information

What will you get in return?

Let’s talk money

  • A salary adequate to your experience and skills between R$37,000and R$44.500. Your salary will be, now and always, 100% transparent to you;

Benefits:

  • 100% remote-friendly within Brazil
  • Working hours are from Monday to Friday, from 9 am to 6 pm;
  • We have compensatory time off (Banco de Horas);
  • Food/Market Voucher;
  • Medical, Dental, and Group Life Insurance;
  • Pet Plan;
  • iFeel app, for emotional comfort;
  • Gympass for you and up to 3 people!
  • Creditas: Payroll loan services, eligible after 6 months of employment;
  • Stock Options- eligible after 6 months of employment (5 years grace period)
  • Birthday Day Off;
  • Daycare Assistance;
  • Partnership Club, with discounts ranging from teaching institutions, such as colleges and language learning services;
  • Referral Program offers up to R$600 per person who stays with us for more than 6 months;
  • Leave of Absence/Time-off: in the event of the passing of loved ones, we offer 10 days off; if your pet passes away, we offer 2 days. Got married? 7 days of rest! Did the baby arrive? We offer 30 days for Dads and 6 months for Moms;

Important: Docplanner is an international English-first company. Therefore, please be sure to send your CV in English

Let’s Make!

Job Description

The E-Commerce Marketing Manager (LATAM Marketplaces) will lead strategy and execution across Mercado Libre and other key Latin American platforms. This role drives growth through marketplace marketing strategies, campaign management, content optimization, and performance analysis, while collaborating with sales, product, and supply chain teams to ensure alignment on pricing, inventory, and brand positioning.

I. Roles and Responsibilities

  • A. Strategic Planning
  • Develop and implement eCommerce marketing strategies for Mercado Libre and other market places in Argentina, Chile, Peru, Colombia, Ecuador, and other assigned accounts.
  • Identify marketing activities that support growth initiatives on marketplace platforms
  • B. Account Management
  • Act as the primary point of contact for marketing activities for assigned accounts.
  • Manage relationships with key stakeholders to ensure alignment on goals and promotions.
  • C. Performance Analysis
  • Monitor and analyze sales performance, traffic metrics, and KPIs for all accounts.
  • Ability to prepare weekly, monthly, quarterly reports and insights for stakeholders.
  • Understand customer search trends & Cricut’s brand positioning within each platform
  • D. Campaign Management
  • Plan and execute marketing campaigns tailored to each platform/marketplace.
  • Manage promotional calendar, including product launches and seasonal promotions.
  • Maintain pacing levels within monthly, quarterly, & annual budgets
  • E. Content Development
  • Oversee the creation and optimization of product listings to improve visibility and conversion rates.
  • Work closely with product marketing to ensure high-quality content
  • Manage brand stores within accounts, ensuring optimal customer shopping experience
  • F. Pricing and Inventory Management
  • Provide discovered insights around pricing & inventory to sales lead. Sales lead will own overall pricing & inventory, but marketing can provide insights from marketing-related findings.
  • Support sales with supply chain and pricing teams to set competitive pricing strategies.
  • Support sales with monitoring inventory levels to prevent stockouts and ensure timely replenishment. Monitor lost buy box % on Amazon.

Comprehensive report outlining quarterly marketing strategies and budget allocations for respective countries and assigned accounts.

Campaign Performance Analysis

Weekly/Monthly/Quarterly performance reports detailing successes, challenges, and opportunities for improvement.

Optimized Product Listings

Regular updates to product listings based on SEO best practices and market trends.

Promotional Calendar

A weekly calendar of promotions and key marketing initiatives for the year.

III. Tasks

A. Daily Tasks

  • Monitor sales and traffic data across all accounts.
  • Respond to inquiries from Amazon account representatives and the third-party reseller.
  • Walk the store of key accounts & channels to ensure positive customer experience

B. Weekly Tasks

  • Review performance metrics and adjust marketing strategies as needed.
  • Audit & optimize paid search accounts (budgets, keyword coverage, cleanup, bid adjustments)
  • Conduct competitor analysis to identify trends and opportunities

C. Monthly Tasks

  • Hold strategy and performance review meetings with stakeholders.
  • Prepare monthly Amazon review deck for key accounts
  • Plan upcoming monthly campaigns and promotional activities.

D. Quarterly Tasks

  • Perform a comprehensive review of account performance and adjust long-term strategies accordingly
  • Conduct search trend audits & ad coverage analysis. Provide sales & broader teams recommended changes in ad coverage
  • Collaborating with sales prepare customer presentations (QBR)
  • Refresh product page, brand store, & advertising content throughout the quarter when necessary (creative rotations, seasonal events, updated assets)

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business, E-Commerce, or related field.
  • 5+ years of e-commerce marketing experience, preferably in LATAM marketplaces like Mercado Libre.
  • Proven experience in campaign management, search and display advertising, content optimization, and marketplace strategy.
  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to track KPIs and deliver actionable insights.
  • Experience managing product listings, brand stores, and promotional calendars.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills; fluent in English and Spanish for LATAM market communication.

Additional Information

Brazil, Mexico, or Argentina-based candidate preferred.

Cricut is in a powerful chapter of transformation. We’re evolving fast—refining our strategy, growing our teams, and raising the bar across the board. This is an incredible opportunity for the right kind of person—but it’s not for everyone.

We’re looking for A-players—people who don’t just meet expectations, but consistently exceed them. If you thrive in dynamic environments and find joy in turning challenges into momentum, keep reading.

Here’s what makes someone a great fit for this role (and for this moment at Cricut):

You have a bias for urgency.

You don’t wait for perfect clarity to take action—you start, learn, and adjust. You believe that speed matters, especially when paired with thoughtfulness. You ask: “What can move forward today?” and push past inertia.

You set high standards—especially for yourself.

You’re proud of your work and protective of your reputation. You take ownership, deliver quality, and don’t cut corners. You hold yourself accountable without waiting to be asked.

You stay focused when things are moving fast.

You can identify what really matters and don’t get distracted by noise. You prioritize well and manage your time wisely.

You elevate the people around you, communicate clearly, and give thoughtful feedback. You’re low ego, high output—and your team loves working with you.

What to Do Next:

Please attach your resume, cover letter and/or include links to your portfolio or other social presence. If you want to show your super powers in other ways – include that information too. You can be sure that Cricut is an employer who values individuality, equality and diversity, so tell us what you’re all about. If you are a Maker or a DIY enthusiast, whether you think you are a good one or not, we would love to hear about it when you send us your information.

Cricut is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. This position is contingent on successfully completing a Criminal Background Check upon hire. Cricut participates in E-Verify.

Conheça um pouco sobre nós:

Nós atuamos no segmento de energia elétrica do Brasil e temos uma história sólida, desde 1912, de contribuição para o desenvolvimento das cidades e estados que atendemos por meio de soluções em geração, transmissão, distribuição, comercialização de energia e prestação de serviços.

Desde 2017, o Grupo faz parte da State Grid, maior empresa de energia elétrica do mundo, fortalecendo a nossa estratégia de crescimento e o protagonismo no setor elétrico brasileiro.

Através das nossas distribuidoras levamos energia para mais de 10 milhões de endereços, o que corresponde a mais de 22 milhões de pessoas atendidas com a eficiência da nossa rede de atendimento.

Acreditamos que equipes plurais e um ambiente inclusivo para todas as pessoas são fundamentais para a sustentabilidade de organizações inovadoras e com foco em clientes, por isso, valorizamos a pluralidade e orientamos nossas ações para garantir uma cultura inclusiva e oportunidades a todas as pessoas.

description:
Overview

Teachable is trusted by creator-educators around the world to grow their impact and income. From online courses and communities to memberships and downloads, Teachable's digital learning products help creator-educators drive meaningful connection and sustainable revenue. With industry-best ecommerce tools, easily toggled on directly within the platform, creators can confidently maximize their earnings, while getting paid directly by their audience. Teachable's unmatched focus on the student learning experience also ensures creators can make a positive and influential impact on their communities—entirely on their own terms. Today, tens of thousands of creator-educators use Teachable to share their knowledge, reaching millions of students around the world. To learn more, visit teachable.com.

Are you ready to join a dynamic, cross-cultural team at an exciting turning point in our company’s journey? Now part of the globalHotmart Company portfolio, whose platforms have helped creators earn more than $10 billion, Teachable continues to take the creator economy by storm as a true industry leader. Together, Teachable and Hotmart are delivering market-leading products that prioritize creator control and flexibility, alongside meaningful partnership and support from our team. If you have big ideas, relish the chance to challenge convention, and deeply believe in the power of creators to shape the future, we want you on our team!

Your Mission

We are seeking a highly analytical and strategic Revenue Operations Sr Analyst to strengthen our sales strategy and accelerate our go-to-market engine in a rapidly growing SaaS company. You will partner with Sales, Finance, Product, Marketing, and Data teams to design scalable processes, implement effective incentives and structures, and ensure execution aligns with business priorities. This is a high-impact role with strong visibility and influence across the organization.

Key Responsibilities

  • Partner with Sales and executive leadership to define the go-to-market strategy —including segmentation, sales motions, and revenue growth priorities.
  • Design and continuously refine quota-setting frameworks, territory models, and headcount planning to enable scalable growth.
  • Develop compensation strategies and incentive structures that drive exceptional performance while aligning with company objectives.
  • Build and manage strategic dashboards and frameworks to monitor sales productivity, forecast accuracy, CAC payback, and other core SaaS KPIs; conduct deeper analysis using Excel/Google Sheets as needed.
  • Translate business questions into analytical projects , delivering actionable insights to guide product focus, market entry, and commercial efficiency.
  • Drive operational rigor through annual/quarterly planning cycles, cross-functional alignment, and performance reviews.
  • Identify and implement process improvements across tools, data flows, and CRM workflows (HubSpot) to enhance efficiency at scale.

Requirements

  • 3–4 years of experience in Revenue Operations, Sales Operations, or Business Operations , preferably within a SaaS or technology company.
  • Strong proficiency in Excel/Sheets and CRM tools (HubSpot knowledge is a plus | SQL, Python is a plus ).
  • Solid understanding of SaaS metrics, sales cycles, and revenue motions (new business, upsell, retention).
  • Excellent communication skills in English (both written and verbal).
  • Proven ability to collaborate cross-functionally and independently lead complex initiatives.
  • Comfortable presenting insights and recommendations to senior leadership .
  • Bachelor’s degree in Economics, Business, Engineering, or a related field .

Why Join Us?

  • Opportunity to work in a high-growth SaaS environment with global exposure.
  • Direct impact on go-to-market strategy and revenue growth .
  • Collaborative, data-driven, and entrepreneurial culture .
  • Competitive compensation and benefits package.

This is a role based in Brazil, and you’ll collaborate closely with teams across the U.S. and Brazil. Your work will follow Brasilia Standard Time (BRT), and you’ll be hired as a CLT contract employee with compensation in BRL.

While Teachable maintains our NY office for local employees to use, we operate as a remote-first culture in order to give our employees added flexibility. In order to maintain connection and create a community beyond the screen, Teachable holds in-person events throughout the year, where employees and teams can come together for bonding, strategic alignment, goal-setting, and celebrations!

Teachable encourages individuals from a broad diversity of backgrounds to apply for positions. We are an equal opportunity employer, meaning we're committed to a fair and consistent interview process. Please tell us in your application if you require an accommodation to apply for a job or to perform your job.

Application

This position is exclusively for Brazil-based engineering talent on a CLT contract paid in BRL. Relocation will not be considered at this time.

You will be required to speak English daily in written and verbal communication with our global (Brazil and U.S. team).

title: Paid Search Manager
description:
Overview

About Skillshare

Skillshare is the leading learning community for creatives. With more than 30,000 expert-led classes in illustration, design, photography, video, marketing, and more, Skillshare empowers anyone, anywhere to learn new skills, share expertise, and unlock their creative potential.

Hundreds of thousands of member subscribers around the world come to Skillshare to discover new passions, advance careers, and connect with an inspiring community of teachers and peers.

Backed by top investors including Newspring Capital, OMERS Ventures, and Union Square Ventures, our mission is to build the world’s most thriving creative learning community.

The Role

We’re looking for a data-driven and strategic Paid Search Manager to own and optimize our campaigns across the Google Ads portfolio. Reporting to the Performance Marketing Lead, you will be responsible for driving profitable growth and maximizing subscription volume at an efficient CAC. This role sits at the core of our growth engine, requiring a deep understanding of campaign management, data analysis, and cross-functional collaboration to drive subscriptions and improve conversion rates across the funnel. You will be responsible for strategy, execution, and reporting, making data-driven decisions to scale our paid search efforts effectively.

Responsibilities

  • Manage and optimize campaigns across the full Google Ads portfolio, including Search, PMax, YouTube, Video Action, and others.
  • Lead keyword strategy and bidding across both branded and non-branded queries to maximize subscription volume at an efficient CAC.
  • Run a disciplined test-and-learn program across bidding, targeting, and funnel variations, and partner with internal data teams to evolve dashboards that surface actionable insights.
  • Drive Conversion Rate Optimization (CRO) initiatives within your channels by working cross-functionally with engineering and design to develop, implement, and maintain a testing roadmap.
  • Monitor campaign performance, generate actionable insights from data, and communicate data-driven decisions to key stakeholders.
  • Stay current on Google Ads and performance marketing trends, platform changes, privacy regulations, attribution strategies, and AI-powered search features to maximize performance.

What We’re Looking For

  • Experience: You have 3+ years of hands-on experience managing SEM and running PPC campaigns in Google Ads, ideally in a fast-paced environment like a subscription business or an agency.
  • Data-driven mindset: You have fluency in campaign data analysis and optimization, with proficiency in Google Sheets, cohort analysis, and ROAS modeling. You have a proven ability to translate numbers into actions.
  • Platform Expertise: You have a strong understanding of search and Google-owned ad placements, including Search, PMax, YouTube, App Campaigns, and Demand Gen.
  • Cross-functional collaborator: You have the ability to work effectively with product, web, creative, and analytics teams to optimize acquisition performance from end to end.
  • Excellent communicator: You can translate complex insights into clear decisions and communicate effectively to stakeholders within and outside of the marketing team.
  • Strategic owner: You are comfortable owning strategy, execution, and reporting, and are curious, commercially aware, and comfortable making quick decisions.
  • Mission alignment: You’re excited by Skillshare’s vision of building the world’s most thriving creative learning community.

Nice to Haves

  • Experience with other performance marketing channels such as Meta, TikTok, Pinterest, Reddit and others.
  • Experience with international markets outside of the US or managing global accounts.
  • Experience within startup or scale-up environments.
  • Experience working with ed-tech or subscription based companies.

At Skillshare, we believe creativity thrives in an inclusive environment. We’re excited to meet candidates from all backgrounds and experiences. If you’re passionate about what we do but don’t check every single box, we’d still love to hear from you — curiosity and growth matter most to us.

title: Freight Coordinator
description:
Commitment: Full-time (Approx. 40 hours/week)

Company Overview:

Tidal is a Direct Placement Agency that helps job seekers find job opportunities for real growth. We work with stable, responsible businesses experienced in remote hires and are excited to welcome international team members. Tidal is owned and operated by consumer brand owners and operators. We have offshore team-building experience and aim to help businesses leverage global talent.

About This Role:

We are seeking a highly organized and detail-oriented Freight Coordinator to join the Logistics team of one of our valued clients. The right candidate will thrive in a remote setting and be responsible for managing the end-to-end freight scheduling and delivery process. This includes coordinating pickups and deliveries, handling exception management, overseeing return shipments, and ensuring data accuracy. The ideal candidate will be proactive, possess strong communication skills, and have a deep understanding of logistics and freight operations.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Communicate with carriers, freight forwarders, 3PL warehouses, and retail partners to coordinate pickup and delivery schedules.
  • Schedule and confirm inventory pick-ups from 3PL warehouses based on shipping plans.
  • Coordinate delivery appointments with retail partners and carriers to ensure timely arrivals.
  • Manage shipping documentation, including BOLs, labels, packing slips, and invoices.
  • Track shipments in transit and provide timely updates to stakeholders.
  • Monitor delivery status and resolve issues like delays, missed pick-ups, and damage claims.
  • Handle reverse logistics and manage return shipments from stores to 3PL warehouses.
  • Ensure accurate documentation and tracking of returned inventory.
  • Maintain shipment logs, track KPIs, and prepare regular performance reports.
  • Act as the main point of contact for freight scheduling and updates with internal and external teams.

Software/Platforms/Tools:

  • ERP Software (e.g., Netsuite)
  • TMS (Transportation Management Systems)
  • WMS (Warehouse Management Systems)
  • Shipment tracking tools
  • Excel
  • Google Sheets
  • Google Suite
  • Slack
  • Zoom
  • Monday.com

Qualifications:

  • At least 3-5 years of freelancing experience
  • 2+ years of experience in freight coordination, logistics, or supply chain support, ideally with retail and/or 3PL exposure.
  • Strong organizational skills with the ability to handle multiple shipments and exceptions simultaneously.
  • Experience working with ERP (e.g., Netsuite), TMS (Transportation Management Systems), WMS (Warehouse Management Systems), or shipment tracking tools.
  • Excellent English communication skills, both written and verbal.
  • Proficiency with Excel and Google Sheets for shipment tracking and reporting.
  • Ability to work independently in a remote/offshore environment and manage time zones effectively.

Preferred:

  • Prior experience working with U.S.-based logistics operations.
  • Familiarity with retail distribution and reverse logistics processes.

AB InBev is the leading global brewer and one of the top 5 consumer goods companies in the world. With over 500 beer brands, we are the number one or two in many of the main beer markets worldwide, including North America, Latin America, Europe, Asia, and Africa.

By bringing together global tech and commercial functions, the Growth Group enables us to maximize the use of data and drive AB InBev's digital transformation and organic growth around the world.

title: Fund Administrator
description:
Our client is a growing fund services provider with a strong focus on crypto and digital assets. With plans to expand into corporate services, regulatory support, and investor transactions, they are building a forward-looking team to support this growth.

We are seeking a Fund Administrator to support the current Manager of Fund Administration and play a key role in day-to-day fund operations. This mid-level role is designed for someone who wants to grow into management over time as the business evolves.

This role is ideal for a detail-oriented professional with solid fund administration experience and a strong interest in digital assets. The right candidate will be proactive, adaptable, and motivated to build a career in a fast-changing sector.

Full-Time
Schedule: Bahamas time zone
Location: Fully remote (fluent English and Portuguese required, Brazil-based candidates preferred)
Engagement: Independent Contractor
Start Date: ASAP
Monthly Rate: $ (depending on level of experience)

Key Responsibilities

  • Manage investor onboarding and compliance, including KYC/AML checks.

  • Maintain accurate investor registry records (investors, unit/share classes, transactions).

  • Process subscriptions, redemptions, transfers, capital calls, and distributions.

  • Prepare and send investor statements, handle queries, and liaise with custodians.

  • Prepare and review investor reports, financial statements, and regulatory filings.

  • Handle transactions and reporting related to crypto assets (valuation, custody, liquidity).

  • Ensure compliance with AML/KYC, FATCA/CRS, and relevant digital asset regulations.

  • Support the Fund Administration Manager in building processes and internal controls.

  • Liaise with auditors, custodians, and regulators as required.

  • Stay up-to-date with digital asset fund regulations and apply them in operations.

Requirements

  • Approximately 5 years of experience in fund administration, ideally with exposure to digital asset/crypto funds.

  • Strong knowledge of fund operations: NAV calculation, reconciliation, investor reporting, compliance.

  • Hands-on experience with investor services (onboarding, AML/KYC, registry, subscriptions/redemptions, capital calls).

  • Familiarity with crypto-specific operations (custody, valuation, liquidity, transaction handling).

  • Understanding of compliance and regulatory frameworks (AML/KYC, FATCA/CRS).

  • Proficiency in Excel and fund administration software (e.g., Advent, Investran, PFS-PAXUS).

  • High attention to detail and accuracy with financial data.

  • Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.

  • Fluent in English; Portuguese required for Brazil-based applicants.

Nice-to-Haves

  • Relevant certifications (CAIA, CFA, CPA modules, blockchain/crypto finance certifications).

  • Experience with corporate services, regulatory reporting, or investor transactions.

  • Previous exposure to start-up or fast-growing fund administration environments.

  • Growth mindset — staying updated on trends/regulations in digital assets.

  2. Client Interview(s)

  3. Offer & Onboarding

Bonus Points

  • 2–4+ years in marketing/advertising environments (performance creative, concepting, storytelling).

  • Understanding of performance marketing basics (hook hierarchy, thumb-stop, offer framing, mobile-first).
  • Experience building componentized design systems for marketing.

The Opportunity

  • Start part-time freelance; earn your way into a full-time seat within 12 months based on results.
  • Ship work that’s seen by millions, not buried in decks.

GET TO KNOW US

At Wellhub we're revolutionizing workplace wellness. We are hiring a Senior Backend Engineer to our Integrations team in Brazil. This is a Remote – Brazil position, meaning you can work from anywhere within the country. Please note that this role is only open to candidates in Brazil.

As an engineer, you will be responsible for developing highly scalable services and ensuring best software engineering practices are followed. You will have opportunities to participate in architectural decisions, suggest improvements, and interact with the product team and other stakeholders in a collaborative agile environment.

As a senior developer, you are expected to design highly scalable systems from scratch, deliver with minimal guidance, become an expert in the business rules and architecture of our complex environment, and mentor less experienced developers.

As part of the Integrations team, you will design and build scalable APIs, manage the integration process between Wellhub and partners (Club Management Systems), and implement new features at the Partners Portal. This team works on products such as booking and access control APIs; for example, all bookings at Wellhub use this API.

  • Ensure successful deliveries and promote long-term technical health of our journeys

  • Maintain high code quality standards, ensuring developers are proud of their work
  • Provide technical guidance for your team, spreading development best practices such as code review, pair programming, and TDD; eager to learn and share knowledge
  • Mentor less experienced developers
  • Participate in incident resolution and production troubleshooting
  • Live the mission: promote wellbeing in the workplace and create a supportive environment where colleagues feel comfortable taking care of themselves

WHO YOU ARE

  • A true team player who works toward both team and individual goals with experience in web development
  • Experience designing and developing complex modern web applications

  • Experience with cloud-based architectures in AWS
  • Strong communication skills in English and Portuguese
  • Ability to work both autonomously and collaboratively
  • Self-starter who can multi-task and adapt to a fast-growing organization
  • Enjoys working on multiple priorities and projects
  • Tenacious and goal-oriented

WHAT WE OFFER YOU

With thoughtful benefits, emotional wellbeing resources, and a culture that empowers you to take ownership of your role and wellbeing, we create an environment where you can thrive in all dimensions of your life.

Our flexible benefits program allows you to customize some benefits according to your needs.

Our benefits include:

  • WELLHUB: Free Gold+ membership with access to onsite gyms and studios, digital fitness programs, and online wellness resources for meditation, nutrition, and mental wellbeing support. You can add up to three family members to your plan.
  • WELLZ: A complete emotional wellbeing program with personalized journeys and 52 per year of individual therapy sessions plus on-demand content.
  • HEALTHCARE: Health, dental, and life insurance.
  • FLEXIBLE WORK: Flexible First company with hybrid and remote options; home office reimbursement available.

At Boulevard, our Customer Experience team is dedicated to launching, supporting, and strengthening relationships with our clients. As an Onboarding Specialist , Data Migrations , you will play a pivotal role in helping customers transition from legacy systems to the Boulevard platform with minimal disruption and maximum confidence.

You'll be the technical partner behind the scenes—transforming, cleaning, and validating data to ensure accuracy, security, and a seamless migration experience. From pre-sale planning through post-launch cleanup, you'll own end-to-end data migration workflows while collaborating cross-functionally to ensure every customer launch is a success.

What you'll do here:

Pre-Sale & Scoping

  • Meet with prospective clients pre-close to understand their data needs and align migration expectations.
  • Partner with Sales to scope technical requirements and validate feasibility.
  • Participate in customer and prospect calls as a subject matter expert on data migrations.

Data Migration & Import

  • Own and manage full-service and free import migrations from initial planning through final execution.
  • Perform imports using tools such as Flatfile and Google Sheets with high accuracy and consistency.
  • Execute structured QA and validation checks on all data prior to launch.
  • Handle migration-related CFDs/CSRs and execute bulk updates (e.g., pricing changes, contact edits).
  • Clean up migrations on launch day in partnership with Onboarding Specialists, focusing on data integrity.

Cross-Departmental Collaboration

  • Coordinate full-service migrations with teams like Odetta and Customer Operations (COPS).
  • Work closely with Engineering to manage escalations, track bugs, and improve tooling.
  • Partner with COPS and Engineering on Flatfile improvements and onboarding tools.
  • Support Onboarding Specialists in resolving real-time data issues during customer launches.

Operational & Team Support

  • Track migration timelines, coordinate launch calendars, and communicate progress and blockers clearly.
  • Answer internal team questions in shared Slack channels (#onboarding-questions, etc.).
  • Assist in data review for proof-of-concept migrations for strategic accounts.
  • Create and maintain internal documentation and one-sheets related to migrations and tooling.

What you'll need to thrive:

  • 2+ years of hands-on experience managing data migrations or working with platform dashboards.
  • 1+ year of direct experience with Boulevard dashboard and data migrations (preferred).
  • Advanced skills in Google Sheets or Excel -comfortable with formulas, lookups, pivot tables, and structured data manipulation.
  • Strong troubleshooting and technical problem-solving abilities under pressure.
  • Excellent project and time management—able to juggle multiple migrations simultaneously while meeting deadlines.
  • Highly detail-oriented with a strong commitment to data accuracy and security.
  • Clear, confident communicator with the ability to collaborate across departments and work independently.

Bonus Points

  • Familiarity with Flatfile or similar structured import tools.
  • Experience with SaaS onboarding, technical support, or customer implementation.
  • Knowledge of data privacy best practices, especially around marketing consent and HIPAA customer data handling.

How we'll take care of you:

Your starting budgeted cash compensation for this role is between $64,000 - $92,000, depending on your current skills, experience, training, and overall market demands. This total compensation range is subject to change, and there is always room for growth and advancement.

In addition to the wonderful people you'll get to work with and challenging projects that'll push you - Boulevard is here to make sure you're always at the top of your game emotionally, mentally, and physically.

  • Take a break whenever you need with our flexible vacation day policy.
  • Fully remote so you can choose where you want to work. You'll receive a work from home stipend every month.
